definitions.explanation: Actively supporting and defending a person, cause, or right, especially against criticism or opposition. Implies standing up for something one believes in.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擁護|ようご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧し、⟦{現行|げんこう}→現行：13503_genkou⟧⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{擁護|ようご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訴|うった}えた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: He opposed the constitutional amendment and called for the defense of the current constitution.

examples.japanese: スキャンダル⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{擁護|ようご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧がいた。
examples.english: Even in the midst of the scandal, some employees defended the president.

notes:
A formal word often used in legal, political, and human rights contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人権|じんけん}→人権：05416_jinken⟧{擁護|ようご} (human rights advocacy)
- ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧{擁護|ようご} (defending the constitution)
- {擁護|ようご}⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (supporters, defenders — a faction)
- {擁護|ようご}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧ (a position of defending/supporting)

USAGE:
{擁護|ようご} implies taking a stance and actively defending something against attack or criticism. It is stronger than ⟦{支持|しじ}→支持：12933_shiji⟧ (support), which can be passive. ⟦{弁護|べんご}→弁護：10579_bengo⟧ (legal defense) is more specific to courtroom settings.
